icu_admission_anchor: first recorded adult ICU visit_detail start per person -- used to build the first-24-hour exposure-ascertainment window
follow_up_clock_start: In the reference study (doi:10.1371/journal.pdig.0000721) the follow-up clock, and all effect estimates, start at the FIRST CRYSTALLOID administration within the first 24 hours of the ICU stay (the paper's inclusion_start), NOT at ICU admission. This pipeline currently anchors on ICU admission because ICU infusions (inputevents) are outside the OMOP ETL scope -- see reference_paper_extraction.md section 9a. Realign the follow-up clock to first-crystalloid once infusion data is loaded.
time_zero: first recorded adult ICU visit_detail start per person (ICU-admission anchor; see follow_up_clock_start for the reference study's true time zero)
care_site_names: Neuro Surgical Intensive Care Unit (Neuro SICU)
known_limitations: Only MICU/SICU currently maps to OMOP visit_detail concept 32037 Intensive Care
Other ICU locations are identified from care_site_name
The first ICU stay per person is used for initial feasibility
This definition has not yet been compared row-by-row with MIMIC icustays

The ICU-admission anchor here differs from the reference study's follow-up time zero (first crystalloid within the first 24 h); the two coincide only when the first crystalloid is given at ICU admission. Estimates anchored here will not be directly comparable to the paper until the follow-up clock is realigned (see follow_up_clock_start).
